name: Decimal expansion of Sum_{k >= 1} sigma_3(k)/k!, where sigma_3(k) is the sum of cubes of the divisors of k (A001158).
comment: Its irrationality was conjectured by Erdős and Kac in 1953 and was proved by Schlage-Puchta in 2006 and Friedlander et al. in 2007.
link: Paul Erdős and Mark Kac, Problem 4518, American Mathematical Monthly, Vol. 60, No. 1 (1953), p. 47.
John B. Friedlander, Florian Luca, and Mihai Stoiciu, On the irrationality of a divisor function series, Integers, Vol. 7, No. 1 (2007), A31.
Jan-Christoph Schlage-Puchta, The irrationality of a number theoretical series, The Ramanujan Journal, Vol. 12, No. 3 (2006), pp. 455-460, preprint, arXiv:1105.1452 [math.NT], 2011.
author: _Amiram Eldar_, Mar 21 2019
